$comment: This schema powers editor completion. Python performs cross-field and IANA timezone checks.
title: Databricks workflow monitoring configuration

jobs_api_config.description: Optional governed storage override for the Jobs API collector.

workspace_id.description: Databricks workspace ID whose Lakeflow jobs are monitored.

default_timezone.description: Default IANA timezone for SLA deadlines.

workflows.description: Only entries marked active are generated into dashboard SQL.

catalog.description: Unity Catalog catalog for collector tables.

schema.description: Unity Catalog schema for collector tables.

unity_catalog_identifier.description: Catalog or schema name without dots or quoting characters.

job_name.description: Dashboard label for the configured Databricks job ID.

job_id.description: Stable Databricks job ID polled by the collector.

monitoring_status.description: Include this workflow in every dashboard query and metric.

sla.description: Expected completion schedule for this workflow.

monitoring_status.description: Exclude this workflow without deleting its YAML entry.

frequency.description: How often a successful workflow completion is expected.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone. Uses default_timezone when omitted.

first_deadline_date.description: First deadline in a repeating 14-day schedule.

day_of_month.description: Monthly deadline day. Short months use their final day.
